svg.title: Unlimited transmission
svg.desc: "Hi" at 6 bytes/s: window 0 (0x48) and window 1 (0x69), then the tail; below, the same after a 150 ms VOX lead and its 2-slot gap. Rendered by the Encoder.
svg.text: Encoder audio at 48000 Hz, 6 bytes/s (T 16.667 ms, 1500 Hz), no lead-in, the 100 ms tail. Purple: START and STOP; teal: 1; gray: 0.
"Hi" at 6 bytes/s: two windows, then the tail
The same with a 150 ms VOX lead: a steady tone, 2 silent slots, the windows
No tune, no sync train, no END: the first tone after silence is the START of byte 0, and a silent window after the last STOP is the end.
20 slots = 333 ms of signal for 2 bytes; the tail is max(100 ms, 2 slots) of silence. The VOX lead only keys a VOX radio.
